title: Missing `Default Texture Filter`  values
body: ### Tested versions All versions ### System information Irrelevant ### Issue description The `Default Texture Filter` in `Project Settings` only shows: And under Canvas Texture, it shows: And please, before you jump to the conclusion that this is intended, look at this: ### Windowed Mode 1280x720p ### Fullscreen Mode 1920x1080p Please compare the quality of each filtering option. The issue is that none of the default values of texture filter have good quality when viewed from distance. As you can see, Linear Mipmap blurs the image considerably to the point the wooden texture loses its details. Also, look at the grid lines on the old parchment. Linear Mipmap Anisotropic or Nearest Mipmap Anisotropic retains almost the same quality of the intended texture. While this texture is not on an angle (not oblique, but orthogonal to the screen). Mipmap Anisotropic was able retain the details of the textures. The blurriness with standard mipmapping is caused by a poor sampling pattern. The camera's zoom is changing the texture's size relative to the screen. The graphics card sees this as a form of non-uniform scaling, which anisotropic filtering is designed to handle. - Non-uniform sampling: Linear (and Nearest?) Mipmap Anisotropic filtering uses a more intelligent and directional sampling pattern when the texture is scaled unevenly. It samples multiple pixels along the direction of the scaling to preserve detail. - Mipmap Anisotropic Filtering accesses higher-resolution mipmaps, when the 2D texture is zoomed-out, standard mipmapping would choose a low-resolution mipmap and use a square sampling pattern. Anisotropic filtering, however, can sample from a higher-resolution mipmap to preserve detail and texture sharpness, even when the image is scaled down. So, please consider adding the missing 2 filtering options to the Default Texture Filter values. The reason for this, I have hundreds of nested nodes that have textures, sprites and whatnot. My game relies heavily on camera zoom levels and most importantly zooming out a lot. Default mipmap is very blurry and destroys the image quality greatly. Without adding these two filtering options, I have to manually adjust these nested texture nodes to have anisotropic filtering. Which is not ideal. ### Steps to reproduce apply texture filter from project and canvas texture filter ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) none
